info.title: Smart Reminder API
info.description: Versioned API for the Smart Reminder mobile application

weekdays.description: Required only for SELECTED_WEEKDAYS. Sunday is 0 and Saturday is 6.

endDate.description: Inclusive local end date for a finite recurring series.

occurrenceCount.description: Maximum occurrences for a finite recurring series.

confirmed.description: Affirms that the user reviewed and explicitly confirmed the structured preview.

confirmedResolvedAt.description: The resolved first-occurrence instant returned by preview and explicitly confirmed by the user.

text.example: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to call John.

draft.description: Original input is returned so the client can preserve the editable draft.

example.originalText: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to call John.

structured.description: Bounded editable fields. Missing ambiguous fields are null.

confidence.description: Per-field confidence values in the inclusive range 0–1.

ambiguities.description: Required user clarifications with references to supported alternatives.

warnings.description: Unsupported clauses and non-blocking parser warnings; clauses remain visible.

until.description: RFC 3339 instant, 5 minutes to 30 days ahead.

expectedRevision.description: Required when updating an existing installation.
Use 0 when creating preferences for the first time.

errorCode.description: Sanitized stable error code; never raw error text.
